coverage_rule: Terms-only audit. The accessible official source page exposes the product's table of contents and named headings but not licensed claim-level text for a fixed NPC cohort. No character or relationship record is created from a name index alone. Include four source terms that are directly named in the official contents; peoples, orders, deities, dragons as kinds, artifacts, places, rules, and player characters remain terms rather than nodes.
omissions: All Dragons of Autumn Twilight characters and events, including any novel-only characterization, as a separate licensed-fiction witness.
All original TSR modules, later editions, games, adaptations, and expanded/retconned Dragonlance continuities.
Indexed NPCs, creatures, and sidekicks in this adventure, because accessible table-of-contents evidence is insufficient for claim-level character records.
Player characters, generic ancestries/classes, orders, deities, dragon kinds, artifacts, locations, encounter stat blocks, and rules as character nodes.
uncertainties: The official index proves that sections/entities occur in this 5e product but is not sufficient evidence for detailed named-character biographies, relationships, or continuity claims.
Official errata shows that recent printings and D&D Beyond text receive revisions; no cross-printing reconciliation is attempted.
This adventure sets a playable campaign during the War of the Lance. Table-created player characters and outcomes are not fixed novel canon.
evidence_basis: The official D&D Beyond source page identifies the exact 5e adventure, its Krynn/War of the Lance framing, and setting-order term sections. The official staff notice calls it an adventure during the legendary War of the Lance, while errata documents product revision. No wiki, fan source, or unlicensed novel text is used.
